Game Overview

In Lasers and Slimes, the core idea is straightforward: survive an unrelenting barrage of ruthless lasers and slimes in a retro-themed adrenaline rush. Test your reflexes by dodging threats and reclaim your shield to endure the chaos. Precision, quick thinking, and constant movement are key to thriving in this ever-evolving, challenging environment. How long can you last?
